prompt_full:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: one Japanese TELEMO advertising illustration, wide landscape, reference aspect ratio 1585:992. Input image 1 is the approved complete design and sole visual reference. Reproduce the same composition, wording, three recognizable mascot identities, poses, colors and watercolor texture as faithfully as possible. This is a faithful reconstruction, not a redesign. The structured design specification included with this prompt is authoritative; all positions are approximate reference pixels. Render only the single flat finished advertising image, full bleed, no device or browser frame. Upper 62%: luminous blue watercolor sky, soft white clouds, distant pale blue Japanese city skyline and white gently rolling ground; bold cobalt brush-lettered Japanese headline leaning upward to the right at the center with a long hand-painted underline, TELEMO above. Left: cheerful white speech-bubble mascot labeled 話し方, pointing up. Center bottom: cheerful blue-and-white alarm-clock mascot labeled 間の取り方. Right: cheerful bright blue curved right-arrow mascot labeled 切り返し. All have expressive oval eyes, smiles, white gloves, blue/dark navy limbs, white-and-blue sneakers, retro rubber-hose cartoon treatment and running/jumping poses. Preserve all surrounding handwritten Japanese annotations in their original locations. Lower 38%: clean white explanatory section with cobalt vertical rule, large blue bold headline and two navy body lines, then a pale blue rectangular statement panel with gray-blue eyebrow, two-line bold blue/navy message, supporting navy paragraph on the right, small blue underline, slim divider and muted uppercase English motto. Every string in the specification must be spelled verbatim and legible, including Japanese punctuation. Do not invent, omit or rewrite any copy. Preserve the lively hand-painted hero and the calm clean typography in the lower section. Output exactly one opaque image.
